mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals tightening policy, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not cross above 3.5% in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals a robust economic cycle, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both rising in the last month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained upward momentum in the CPIAUCSL index signals inflationary pressures that boost equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods with CPIAUCSL rising are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime does not hold for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (monetary tightening) and decline in unemployment rate (labor market weakening) signals contractionary policy and reduced corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increasing and UNRATE decreasing in the last month
failure_condition: 20-day returns in contractionary periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the trigger condition does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand activity (HOUST) above 1500 units signals robust consumer and business spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with HOUST > 1500 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the threshold is not met.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, falling unemployment rates (UNRATE < 4%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) signal improving labor market conditions and easing, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in post-shock recovery periods with the trigger condition are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime does not hold for the period.

mechanism_narrative: An expansion in supply activity (INDPRO) above 102 units signals robust production and inventory building, which boosts corporate profits and investor sentiment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with INDPRO > 102 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the threshold is not met.
